gen-gf-castoro-fs-bespoke-sans: Castoro builds each letter from heavy, iron-bar stems joined by hairline links as fine as silk thread, which gives it real authority. Bespoke Sans, a plain sans, reads smooth and open beneath it.
gen-gf-catamaran-fs-literata: Catamaran has c and s shapes that look half unwrapped, giving the headings a friendly, contemporary lilt with barely any stroke contrast. Literata, a text serif, handles the sturdy, bookish reading.
gen-gf-caudex-fs-bespoke-sans: Refined and classic, Caudex has a pen-held-steady stroke with a modest shift in weight. Bespoke Sans feels sharper and more open beside it, its curves leaving generous room before they reach the stem.
gen-gf-chathura-fs-literata: Chathura draws its letters with the taut steadiness of a string, compressed so tightly there is almost no pause between them. Literata then takes over the longer reading, its thin and thick strokes close in weight and its curves wide open.
gen-gf-chau-philomene-one-fs-literata: Literata is the bookish one here, with sturdy lines and open curves. If Chau Philomene One, compact and slit-mouthed, gets made small, those tight little openings will start to clog.
gen-gf-chelsea-market-bitter: Chelsea Market is expressive and bold, with a lowercase g whose lower curve stays open and an x-height that climbs skyward. Bitter, a slab-serif, grounds it with big, dependable lowercase forms.
gen-gf-chelsea-market-inter: Expressive and bold, Chelsea Market lets its lowercase g hang open and its x-height climb high. Inter follows with smooth, tube-like lines, so a longer read feels breathable and unfussy.
gen-gf-chelsea-market-mulish: Chelsea Market brings an open-bottomed g and a skyward x-height, so the headings feel expressive and loud. Mulish, a sans with rope-thin, unmodulated strokes, keeps the reading smooth and approachable.
gen-gf-chelsea-market-poppins: Loud, loose and cheerful, with a g that never quite closes. Poppins, a sans-serif with rope-loose curves and no thick-thin flicker, is the quality that keeps Chelsea Market's boldness in check.
gen-gf-chelsea-market-rubik: A lowercase g with an open lower curve and a skyward x-height mark Chelsea Market as expressive and bold. And Rubik, a soft sans-serif with big, round letters, keeps a longer read clear.
